title: Fault-Injection Resilience Scoring for Constitutional Principles

original_idea.body:
# Fault-Injection Resilience Scoring for Constitutional Principles

**Problem:** We don't know which constitutional principles are load-bearing for safety.

**Direction:** Drop/corrupt one principle at a time in a self-critique pipeline, measure change in harmful-output rate, rank principles by criticality.

**Why it matters:** Exposes single points of failure and dead weight. Inference-only.

**Relevant context:** arXiv:2309.11274; arXiv:2404.13038.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Identifying load-bearing constitutional principles exposes single points of failure in a widely used method.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Inference-only principle ablation in a self-critique loop; beginner-accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused principle-criticality ranking; needs a probe set and critique pipeline.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open critique prompts, no lab data; independent-friendly infrastructure work.

novelty.reasoning: Systematic per-principle fault-injection criticality scoring appears largely unexplored.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Per-principle ablation criticality scoring appears largely unexplored.
